portfolio.title: Me, Myself & React
portfolio.learn: component composition, responsive design, routing, form submission, deployment (Vercel / Netlify), SEO
portfolio.beginner: a single-page introduction with skills and contact details
portfolio.intermediate: project cards, separate pages, a working contact form
portfolio.advanced: content from a CMS, a blog, animations, a Lighthouse score of 90+, a custom domain

dark-mode.title: Dark Mode
dark-mode.learn: Context API, CSS custom properties, `useEffect` and `matchMedia`, a custom `useDarkMode` hook
dark-mode.beginner: a toggle that switches the page colors
dark-mode.intermediate: remember the choice and follow the system setting (`prefers-color-scheme`)
dark-mode.advanced: multiple themes, flicker-free loading, animated transitions, Context-based theming for a whole app

password-generator.title: Password Generator
password-generator.learn: controlled form inputs (slider, checkboxes), random-number logic, the Clipboard API
password-generator.beginner: generate a password of a given length, with a copy button
password-generator.intermediate: toggles for lowercase, uppercase, digits and symbols, a strength meter
password-generator.advanced: `crypto.getRandomValues` instead of `Math.random`, pronounceable passwords, a check against known data breaches

mad-libs.title: Mad Libs
mad-libs.learn: controlled form fields, string templates and concatenation, conditional rendering
mad-libs.beginner: a few fields (name, animal, verb) turned into a funny story
mad-libs.intermediate: multiple or random templates, fields generated from the template, restart
mad-libs.advanced: custom templates with `{noun}` placeholders, a shareable link, read-aloud (Speech Synthesis API), two-player mode

qr-code.title: QR Code Generator
qr-code.short: QR codes from text or links
qr-code.learn: using an external npm package, controlled inputs, downloading a file from the browser
qr-code.beginner: enter text or a link and render the QR code with a library
qr-code.intermediate: color, size, a logo in the center, download as PNG and SVG
qr-code.advanced: scan QR codes with the camera, Wi-Fi and contact QR types, history

flashcards.title: Flashcards
flashcards.learn: 3D CSS card-flip animation, step-by-step logic, shuffling, persistence with the `useLocalStorage` hook
flashcards.beginner: cards with a question and an answer that flip on click, previous / next buttons
flashcards.intermediate: custom decks, “know it / don't know it” marking, shuffle, progress bar, saving
flashcards.advanced: harder cards return more often (spaced repetition), images on cards, import / export, shareable decks

color-palette.title: Color Palette Generator
color-palette.learn: arrays in state (updating via copies), keyboard events, the Clipboard API, color codes
color-palette.beginner: 5 random colors on a click, hex codes, copy to clipboard
color-palette.intermediate: lock colors, press space for a new palette, save favorites
color-palette.advanced: harmonious palettes based on color theory, contrast checks (WCAG), export as CSS variables, a shareable link

calculator.title: Calculator
calculator.learn: `useState`, event handling, components and props (buttons), conditional rendering
calculator.beginner: number buttons, the four basic operations, result, clear (C)
calculator.intermediate: keyboard input, decimals, percent, sign toggle, a history list
calculator.advanced: operator precedence and parentheses, scientific functions, a custom expression parser, tests

todo.title: To-Do List
todo.learn: rendering lists with `key`, create/update/delete in state, filtering, `useEffect`, a custom `useLocalStorage` hook
todo.intermediate: editing, filters (all / active / done), persistence with the `useLocalStorage` hook
todo.advanced: due dates and priorities, drag-to-reorder, a backend with a database and login, tests

shopping-list.title: Shopping List
shopping-list.learn: grouping and sorting arrays, controlled forms, persistence with the `useLocalStorage` hook
shopping-list.beginner: add items with a quantity, check them off, delete them
shopping-list.intermediate: categories (produce, dairy, …), saving, completed items move to the bottom
shopping-list.advanced: a shared real-time list for several users, offline support (PWA), suggestions from past items

notes.title: Notes App
notes.learn: create/update/delete, search and filtering with derived values, date handling, the `useLocalStorage` hook
notes.intermediate: categories, search, persistence with the hook, last-edited date
notes.advanced: rich text (Markdown), tags, sync across devices with a backend, offline mode

image-gallery.title: Image Gallery & Carousel
image-gallery.learn: `setInterval` and cleanup in `useEffect`, modal dialogs, file upload, keyboard events
image-gallery.beginner: images in a grid, a large view on click
image-gallery.intermediate: image upload, an auto-advancing carousel with manual controls, arrow keys
image-gallery.advanced: lazy loading, infinite scroll, albums, cloud image hosting, drag-to-reorder

memory-game.title: Memory Game
memory-game.learn: more complex state (cards, the selected pair), `setTimeout`, shuffling, CSS animations
memory-game.beginner: flip cards, find pairs, a “you won” message
memory-game.intermediate: move counter, timer, flip animation, difficulty levels (grid size)
memory-game.advanced: best scores, themes (emoji, images from an API), two-player mode, keyboard controls

currency-converter.title: Currency Converter
currency-converter.learn: data fetching with `fetch`, loading and error states, a custom `useFetch` hook, an API key in an environment variable
currency-converter.beginner: an amount and two currencies, conversion at a fixed rate
currency-converter.intermediate: live rates from an API via the `useFetch` hook, a swap button, error handling
currency-converter.advanced: a 30-day rate chart, favorite currency pairs, caching, the last known rate offline

space-explorer.title: Space Explorer
space-explorer.short: NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day
space-explorer.learn: APIs with a key, date handling, rendering by media type (image / video), caching
space-explorer.beginner: today's picture with its title and explanation
space-explorer.intermediate: a date picker for the archive, favorites, handling video days
space-explorer.advanced: more NASA data (e.g. Mars photos) with filters, infinite scroll, a gallery with a large view

typing-test.title: Typing Speed Test
typing-test.learn: `useRef`, timing and stopping the timer, computing on every keystroke, avoiding unnecessary re-renders
typing-test.beginner: type a passage, measure the time, show characters per minute
typing-test.intermediate: live highlighting (correct / wrong), words per minute and accuracy, timed mode (30 / 60 s)
typing-test.advanced: a live chart while typing, history and progress, a leaderboard, a multiplayer race

piano.title: Musical Instrument
piano.learn: keyboard events, `useRef` for sounds, UI generated from an array, the Web Audio API
piano.beginner: piano keys that play a sound on click
piano.intermediate: play with the computer keyboard, multiple octaves, a choice of instrument sounds
piano.advanced: sound synthesis with the Web Audio API, record and play back, MIDI keyboard support, a melody-teaching mode

video-player.title: Video Player
video-player.learn: `useRef` for the DOM element, the HTML5 video API (`play`, `currentTime`), custom controls, accessibility
video-player.beginner: play a video with a custom play / pause button
video-player.intermediate: seek bar, volume, fullscreen, playback speed, keyboard shortcuts
video-player.advanced: a playlist, subtitles, resume where you left off, picture-in-picture

wordle.title: Wordle-style Game
wordle.learn: global keyboard events, a grid in state, game logic, animations
wordle.beginner: guess a 5-letter word in 6 tries with colored feedback
wordle.intermediate: an on-screen keyboard showing letter states, a valid-word check, animations
wordle.advanced: a daily word (the same for everyone), statistics and streaks, results shared as an emoji grid, a Hungarian word list

movie-search.title: Movie Search
movie-search.learn: routing (React Router) with parameters, custom `useFetch` and `useDebounce` hooks, empty and error states
movie-search.beginner: a search box, results with title and poster
movie-search.intermediate: a detail page, search that starts once typing stops (debounce), “no results” handling
movie-search.advanced: pagination or infinite scroll, filters by year and genre, favorites, the search kept in the URL

book-library.title: Book Library
book-library.learn: searching an API, moving items between lists, the `useFetch` hook, transforming API data
book-library.beginner: your own book list (title, author) with a reading status
book-library.intermediate: book search via an API (Open Library / Google Books), shelves: reading / read / want to read
book-library.advanced: ratings and notes, a reading goal and statistics, login and cloud saving

multi-step-form.title: Multi-Step Form
multi-step-form.learn: form state across steps, validation, React Hook Form and Zod, user experience
multi-step-form.beginner: three steps with back / next buttons, a summary at the end
multi-step-form.intermediate: per-step validation, a progress indicator, data kept when switching steps
multi-step-form.advanced: React Hook Form + Zod, conditional steps, saved drafts, submission to an API

fan-wiki.title: Fan Wiki
fan-wiki.learn: list and detail views from an API, dynamic routing, search and filtering, pagination
fan-wiki.beginner: a list of characters with image and name
fan-wiki.intermediate: a detail page for each character, search and filters, data from an API
fan-wiki.advanced: pagination, relationships between characters, an episode list, editable entries

review-rating.title: Review & Rating App
review-rating.learn: a reusable component (stars), derived data (averages), sorting and filtering, later a backend
review-rating.beginner: a list of items, star ratings, written reviews
review-rating.intermediate: average rating, sorting by rating, filters, a detail page
review-rating.advanced: login, one review per user, “helpful” votes, moderation, a backend

meme-generator.title: Meme Generator
meme-generator.learn: drawing on canvas, image upload, templates from an API, downloading images
meme-generator.beginner: pick an image and add top and bottom text
meme-generator.intermediate: popular templates from an API, upload your own image, font, size, color, download
meme-generator.advanced: drag and rotate text boxes, stickers, a meme gallery and sharing

blog.title: Blog Platform
blog.learn: routing, create/update/delete, rendering Markdown, later a backend and database
blog.beginner: a list of posts and a single post page
blog.intermediate: write, edit and delete posts, Markdown support
blog.advanced: a backend with a database, author login, comments, tags, search, SEO

piggy-bank.title: Piggy Bank / Wallet
piggy-bank.learn: complex state with `useReducer`, calculations over arrays (`reduce`), charts (Recharts), data export
piggy-bank.beginner: deposits and withdrawals, the current balance
piggy-bank.intermediate: categories, a filterable transaction list, a savings goal with a progress bar, saving
piggy-bank.advanced: monthly charts, multiple wallets and currencies, recurring items, CSV export

subscriptions.title: Subscription Tracker
subscriptions.learn: date calculations (next renewal), totals, sorting, browser notifications
subscriptions.beginner: a list of subscriptions with name and monthly price, plus a total
subscriptions.intermediate: monthly and yearly views, renewal dates, categories, logos
subscriptions.advanced: a reminder before renewal, a spending chart, currency conversion, “which one should I cancel?” suggestions

plant-care.title: Plant Care Tracker
plant-care.learn: time-based logic (when to water), image upload, browser notifications, PWA basics
plant-care.beginner: a list of plants with name and photo
plant-care.intermediate: watering frequency, an “I'm thirsty” indicator, a watering log
plant-care.advanced: notifications, care data from an API, an installable app (PWA)

mood-tracker.title: Mood Tracker
mood-tracker.learn: date handling, generating a calendar grid, charts, aggregating data
mood-tracker.beginner: pick today's mood with an emoji and add a short note
mood-tracker.intermediate: a color-coded calendar view, saving, day details on click
mood-tracker.advanced: a mood trend chart, correlations (sleep, exercise), a weekly summary, reminder notifications

virtual-pet.title: Virtual Pet (Tamagotchi-style)
virtual-pet.learn: state that changes over time, computing time elapsed while closed, `useReducer`, animations, saving
virtual-pet.beginner: a pet with stats (hunger, mood), feed and play buttons
virtual-pet.intermediate: stats decrease over time, the look follows the mood, saving
virtual-pet.advanced: time passes even when the page is closed, growth stages, mini-games, notifications

snake.title: Snake
snake.learn: a game loop (`setInterval` / `requestAnimationFrame`), `useRef` for fresh state, collision detection, canvas
snake.beginner: move the snake with the arrow keys, eat food, grow
snake.intermediate: wall and self collisions, score, increasing speed, pause
snake.advanced: canvas rendering, high scores, levels with obstacles, swipe controls on mobile

lofi-room.title: Lofi Study Room
lofi-room.learn: playing several sounds at once, sliders, a timer with cleanup, atmospheric CSS
lofi-room.beginner: a background image and lofi music playback
lofi-room.intermediate: ambient sounds (rain, café, fire) with separate volumes, a focus timer
lofi-room.advanced: themes (night city, forest), a to-do list in the room, study statistics, a shared room with friends in real time

wardrobe.title: Digital Wardrobe
wardrobe.learn: image upload and handling, multi-criteria filtering, a weather API, generating combinations
wardrobe.beginner: upload clothing items with a photo and category
wardrobe.intermediate: build outfits, filter by color, season and occasion
wardrobe.advanced: “what should I wear today?” based on the current weather, a wear log, background removal from photos

drawing.title: Drawing App
drawing.learn: the Canvas API, mouse and touch events, `useRef`, undo (history stack), exporting images
drawing.beginner: draw with the mouse and pick a color
drawing.intermediate: brush size, eraser, undo, save as an image
drawing.advanced: layers, shapes, touch and stylus support, collaborative drawing in real time

winamp.title: Winamp Clone
winamp.learn: audio handling, playlist state, OAuth login (Spotify), audio visualization, custom retro CSS
winamp.beginner: a retro-style player for your own music files: play, pause, next
winamp.intermediate: playlist, seek bar, volume, shuffle and repeat
winamp.advanced: the Spotify API with login, an audio visualizer with the Web Audio API, swappable skins

job-tracker.title: Job Application Tracker
job-tracker.learn: drag & drop (dnd-kit), create/update/delete, filtering, dates and reminders, statistics
job-tracker.beginner: a list of applications (company, role, date, status)
job-tracker.intermediate: status columns with drag & drop (applied → interview → offer), search, filters
job-tracker.advanced: interview reminders, statistics (response rate), attached résumé versions, login and cloud saving

kanban.title: Kanban Board
kanban.learn: drag & drop with a library (dnd-kit), nested state (columns → cards), `useReducer`
kanban.beginner: three columns (To-Do / In Progress / Done), add cards
kanban.intermediate: drag between columns, priorities (High / Medium / Low), editing, saving
kanban.advanced: multiple boards, due dates, team members, real-time collaboration, a backend

photo-booth.title: Photo Booth
photo-booth.learn: camera access (`getUserMedia`), drawing on canvas, filters, timing, creating images and GIFs
photo-booth.beginner: the webcam feed on the page, take a photo with a button
photo-booth.intermediate: countdown, a four-shot photo strip, filters, download
photo-booth.advanced: polaroid and custom frames, face-tracking stickers, GIF creation, a gallery

mood-board.title: Mood Board
mood-board.learn: free dragging and resizing, storing positions, image upload, managing multiple boards
mood-board.beginner: upload images and notes to a board
mood-board.intermediate: drag items freely, resize them, multiple boards
mood-board.advanced: extract color palettes from images, image search via the Unsplash API, shareable boards, export as an image

swipe.title: Swipe Picker (Tinder-style)
swipe.learn: gestures (pointer events), animations (Framer Motion), APIs, later shared real-time state
swipe.beginner: cards one after another with yes / no buttons
swipe.intermediate: swipe cards left and right with animation, movies or dishes from an API
swipe.advanced: a shared room for two people, matches in real time, filters (genre, cuisine)

travel-map.title: Travel Bucket List
travel-map.learn: a map library (React Leaflet), markers, geographic data (GeoJSON), image upload
travel-map.beginner: a list of places: been there / want to go
travel-map.intermediate: a map with markers, notes and photos for each place
travel-map.advanced: visited countries highlighted on a world map, statistics (countries, continents), a shareable map

data-table.title: Data Table
data-table.learn: sorting, filtering and pagination logic, TanStack Table, performance with large data sets, server-side data handling
data-table.intermediate: sort by clicking a column, search, filters, pagination
data-table.advanced: inline editing, multi-row selection, rendering thousands of rows smoothly, server-side pagination, export

webshop.title: E-commerce Store
webshop.learn: global state management (Context / Redux / Zustand), routing, cart logic, payment integration
webshop.beginner: a product list and product pages
webshop.intermediate: a cart with global state, totals, filters, search
webshop.advanced: checkout, test payments (Stripe test mode), order management, an admin panel, login

auth.title: User Authentication System
auth.learn: form validation, protected routes, tokens and sessions, Firebase / Supabase, then a custom backend
auth.beginner: sign-up and login forms with validation
auth.intermediate: login with a hosted service (Firebase / Supabase), protected pages, logout
auth.advanced: a custom backend with JWT or sessions, password reset by email, Google sign-in, roles

feed.title: Reddit-style Feed
feed.learn: recursive components (comment tree), instant UI updates when voting, infinite scroll, a backend
feed.beginner: a list of posts with up / down votes
feed.intermediate: sorting (newest / top), single-level comments, writing new posts
feed.advanced: nested comments of any depth, communities, login, infinite scroll, a backend

booking.title: Booking App
booking.learn: date and time handling (date-fns), booking conflicts, forms, a backend and database, time zones
booking.beginner: a list of services, choose a time from a fixed list
booking.intermediate: a calendar with free and booked slots, a booking form, confirmation
booking.advanced: an admin panel for opening hours, conflict handling, email reminders, a backend

ai-chat.title: AI Chat Assistant
ai-chat.learn: handling streamed responses, a backend that hides the API key, rendering Markdown and code, state for multiple conversations
ai-chat.beginner: a chat interface: send a message, show the reply
ai-chat.intermediate: connect an AI API, replies that stream in as they are typed, conversation history
ai-chat.advanced: a backend for the API key, multiple conversations, code highlighting, an assistant that answers from your own documents

retro-os.title: Retro OS Desktop
retro-os.short: A Windows 95-style desktop in the browser
retro-os.learn: window-management state (position, stacking order, focus), dragging and resizing, an architecture built from mini apps, Context
retro-os.beginner: a desktop with icons, a Start menu, a clock in the taskbar
retro-os.intermediate: windows that open, drag and close, with the clicked one always on top
retro-os.advanced: resizing, minimizing to the taskbar, mini apps (notepad, minesweeper, player), saved state

chat.title: Real-Time Chat / Slack Clone
chat.learn: WebSocket / Socket.io or Supabase Realtime, real-time state, a backend, users and channels
chat.beginner: a chat interface with a local message list
chat.advanced: channels, direct messages, a “typing…” indicator, online status, file sharing, your own Socket.io server
